note: F5's first engine code, and the first task of this feature with no licence escalation. Learn scan outcome: no lesson met the bar. The one genuinely surprising discovery — mediapipe 0.10.35 ships ONLY the tasks package, with no mediapipe.solutions, so the familiar FACEMESH_LIPS / FACEMESH_FACE_OVAL constants do not exist and the Tasks API's FaceLandmarksConnections must be used instead — is a FACT about the pinned dependency, not a failure mode a rule would prevent. It cost three tool calls, was resolved immediately, and is already captured where it will be needed again: a source comment at facedetect.py:62-68 and the handoff. Turning it into a guardrail would be inventing a lesson to have something to show. Note the guardrail UPDATE proposed by Task 3's scan (check an asset's own embedded EXIF/XMP metadata first) remains PARKED and unapproved in handoff.md; it is deliberately not conflated with this task's outcome. No ADR: fails condition 1 — this is a straightforward implementation of a pipeline whose order was already fixed by spec.md 4, with nothing hard to reverse. The verifier recorded ONE non-blocking observation carried forward to Task 5 rather than treated as a Task 4 defect: acquire_camera clears error_message on entry (facedetect.py:114) but never resets status on success, so a successful re-acquire after a prior failure would leave status == ERROR with no message. capture.py:79 sets status on its success path; the analog here is Task 5's start(), which plan.md explicitly owns, and it bears directly on Task 5's criterion (6) 'a second start after stop works'. No idea was declined by the human during this task, so no .out-of-scope/ file was owed.
